_comment_version: Do not change the version number! It is used for automatic config updates.

quests._comment_reroll: Settings for quest rerolling mechanics. Costs are in Total Points.
quests._comment_xp: Experience points granted for completing quests of different difficulties.

streaks._comment_perfect_days: How many 'Perfect Days' (all 5 quests completed) are needed to get a Quest Shield.
streaks._comment_shields: Maximum amount of Quest Shields and Reward Shields a player can hold at once.

technical._comment_cache: Maximum amount of placed blocks remembered by the server to prevent block-break and block-place quests abuse.
technical._comment_leaderboard: How often (in ticks) the leaderboard cache is updated (1200 ticks = 1 minute).
technical._comment_refresh: Hour of the day (0-23) when daily quests and rewards refresh (0 = midnight).
